column1: # The entries of the 1876 State Department Red Cipher (John H. Haswell), column 'Message or true reading', that the contributor used for this telegram (issue #353). The codebook itself is NARA catalog id 417267710 (page 561 is the page of 561xx); the project could not reach the page images, so these entries are the contributor's, not checked here. The first three digits of a group give the printed page, the last two the entry.
# Spelling: the first group 56169 is the spelling key; rows 5 6 1 6 of the first division of the spelling table, coded letters U A W C read at the tops of their columns give K I E L.
